name: HEALTH MATE THERAPY LOUNGE  INFRARED SAUNA
description: Want to sweat fast with a built in lounger? The therapy lounge will allow just that. The ultimate sauna for even the tallest of individuals. This model allows people up to 6’ 5” tall to fully lie down. For added user comfort we have integrated a built-in lounger into the bench that supports the head, back, and knees. If you want a Health Mate that has plenty of room then the therapy lounge is for you.
